faq.question: How much does AgenditApp cost?
faq.answer: Plans start at $10 USD/month (Basic) up to $30 USD/month (Own Brand). All plans are month-to-month with no contracts. They include unlimited bookings and WhatsApp support.

faq.question: Is there a contract or cancellation fee?
faq.answer: No. Every plan is month-to-month and you can cancel anytime with no penalties or paperwork.

faq.question: Do reminders come from my own WhatsApp number?
faq.answer: Yes. On plans that include WhatsApp, messages are sent from your official WhatsApp Business number, not from an unknown number.

faq.question: How many bookings can I receive with AgenditApp?
faq.answer: Unlimited on every plan. There's no extra charge based on the number of bookings or clients.

faq.question: Do my clients need to download an app to book?
faq.answer: No. Your clients book from a web link you can share on WhatsApp, Instagram, or social media. Nothing to install.

faq.question: What kinds of businesses can use AgenditApp?
faq.answer: If you work with appointments, AgenditApp is for you. It's used by salons, barbershops, spas, medical practices, psychologists, dentists, nutritionists, veterinary clinics, gyms, photography studios, music/yoga/dance instructors, tutors, and more.

faq.question: Do I need technical knowledge to use the platform?
faq.answer: No. AgenditApp is designed to be intuitive and easy to use. We provide onboarding and technical support so you can get started from day one.

faq.question: Can I manage multiple staff members?
faq.answer: Yes. Each staff member has their own schedule, services, and calendar. You can see everything from one dashboard and manage commissions automatically.
